purpose: Execute the atomic create-block-from-bounds operation within the MA-05 boundary: One root-part block created with BlockBody.Create(..., ExtrudeType.ForceIndependent). The current variant is root-only, does not accept a component or name, and does not batch multiple blocks.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires create-block-from-bounds and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: min_mm
inputs.description: Finite minimum corner coordinates in millimetres.

inputs.name: max_mm
inputs.description: Finite maximum corner coordinates in millimetres; every component must exceed min_mm.

inputs.name: bbox_tolerance_mm
inputs.description: Tolerance used to compare the created body's axis-aligned bounding box.

preconditions: All bounds and tolerance values are finite; max_mm is strictly greater than min_mm on all axes.
The root-part body collection can be enumerated.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: The one newly detected current root-part body that passes the bounding-box and closed-solid checks.

postconditions: Exactly one new body is found by comparing current root bodies with the pre-action collection.
The new body's bounds match min_mm + max_mm within bbox_tolerance_mm.
assert_closed confirms a closed, nonempty body.
